column3:
Return Lock Ring Tools To Board. This NOTICE Rim Tool Board sign from CGAP Safety reads: RIM TOOL BOARD / RETURN LOCK RING TOOLS / BEFORE LEAVING BENCH. Written for commercial tire dealers, truck repair shops, fleet maintenance garages, farm and equipment tire service.

Why this sign matters

Keeps lock ring tools on their hooks so the next truck wheel job is not delayed by a search.

Where to post it

Mount on the pegboard or wall directly above the rim tool board.

Who orders it

Truck tire shop managers, fleet maintenance supervisors, service managers.

Rust-resistant .065 aluminum, UV-resistant print, pre-drilled in all four corners. Made in the USA. Related standards and practice to review for your site: Site practice. A sign supports your site procedures; it does not replace training or supervision.

Wipe Shaft And Cones Between Wheels. This NOTICE Wheel Balancer Spindle sign from CGAP Safety reads: WHEEL BALANCER SPINDLE / WIPE SHAFT AND CONES / BETWEEN EVERY WHEEL. Written for tire shops, dealerships, wheel shops and fleet garages.

Why this sign matters

Keeps debris off the shaft and cones so readings stay accurate.

Where to post it

Mount on the balancer housing near the spindle.

Who orders it

Tire shop managers, service managers, tire technicians and dealership fixed-ops directors.

Rust-resistant .065 aluminum, UV-resistant print, pre-drilled in all four corners. Made in the USA. Related standards and practice to review for your site: Site practice; wheel balancer manufacturer operating manual. A sign supports your site procedures; it does not replace training or supervision.
